name: mstack-skill-creator
description: Create or improve agent skills (SKILL.md folders) that Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor all load: an interview, a check for an existing skill, writing by portable rules, a static check, a comparison test against a baseline, and for an mstack-style repository the full plugin packaging and cross-vendor review. Uses the other mstack skills when they are installed. Never commits or publishes on its own.

interface.shortDescription: Create and test skills that four agent hosts load.
interface.longDescription: Interviews the user, checks for a skill that already does the job, writes one SKILL.md folder by rules that Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor share, checks it with a script, and runs the same task with and without it. In a repository laid out like mstack it also adds the manifests, registry entries, license, notices and version changes, runs the repository's checks, and gets a cross-vendor review.
